source: Allard & Atalla 2e Table 12.2, PDF page 298 (printed p. 293)
about: Table 12.2, printed as "Parameters of the steel wool-laminated plate system" for what the prose calls a double wall of a steel plate, a mineral wool and a laminated plate, the example taken from Villot et al. (2001) and measured on a 1.3 x 1.3 m system under a diffuse field (Figure 12.5). Columns as printed: thickness h (mm), phi, sigma (N s/m4), alpha_inf, Lambda (um), Lambda' (um), rho_1 (kg/m3), E (Pa), nu and eta_s. The mineral wool is the one porous row. The steel plate (0.75 mm, 7850 kg/m3, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, eta 0.03) and the laminated plate (3 mm, 1360 kg/m3, E 6e8, nu 0.15, eta 0.15) are not porous materials and are not here.
